projectSummary: The same research group that mapped innervation-zone shift states here, in print, that the inclination literature is contradictory and that measurement artefact is the likely reason. This is the anchor of the contradiction map for tier-4 bench press evidence.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: flat bench press; 45-degree inclined bench press
study.population: Single-differential EMGs were collected from 15 regions along the cranio-caudal axis of the pectoralis major while 8 volunteers performed a set of the flat and of the 45-degree inclined bench press at 50 and 70 per cent of 1RM.

title: Non-uniform excitation of the pectoralis major muscle during flat and inclined bench press exercises.
